evals.prompt: Add a Slack notification step after the generate-summary action in my workflow
evals.expected_output: The skill fetches the workflow, adds a new Slack notification node connected to the generate-summary node, and updates the workflow via PATCH API
expectations: Adds new node with actionType: slack/send-message
Creates new edge from generate-summary to the new node
Reports changes to user with workflow link

evals.prompt: Remove the second action node from this workflow - I don't need it anymore
evals.expected_output: The skill removes the specified node and its connected edges, then updates the workflow
expectations: Removes the target node from nodes array
Removes all edges connected to/from that node

evals.prompt: Change the AI model in my text-generation node from GPT-4 to Claude Sonnet
evals.expected_output: The skill updates the config of the specified node and saves the workflow
expectations: Fetches the workflow to find the node
